lead: Ryan Gosling is a widely followed Canadian television actor, born on 12 November 1980 in London.
As of 2026, he is 45 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He is associated with work such as The Fall Guy, The Notebook and Barbie and has been recognised with India Catalina Awards and Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy.
The sections that follow break down Ryan Gosling's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
